name: Jameson Ford
bio:
Jameson Ford's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's garage. This hands-on experience led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. His professional career started in IndyCar, where he honed his skills in data analysis, simulation, and trackside support. After a decade in IndyCar, Jameson transitioned to sports car racing, seeking new challenges and opportunities to apply his expertise.

Jameson's approach to performance engineering is methodical and data-driven. He believes in building strong relationships with drivers and mechanics to create a collaborative environment. He is known for his ability to quickly identify and address performance bottlenecks, optimizing vehicle setup for varying track conditions. What sets Jameson apart is his calm demeanor under pressure, a crucial asset in the high-stakes world of motorsport.

His experience with Ipiranga Racing has been rewarding, and he hopes to take them to the top of the podium.
